div.head: V Atr 10
div.ab: ⁊ æghwylc Cristen man eac unriht hæmed georne forbuge ⁊ godcunde laga rihtlice healde.
⁊ æghwylc Cristen man eac unriht hæmed georne forbuge ⁊ godcunde laga rihtlice healde.
And æghwilc Cristen man unriht hæmed georne forbuge ⁊ godcunde laga rihtlice healde.
And æghwylc Cristen man eac unrihthæmed georne forbuge and godcunde laga rihtlice healde.
Und auch jeder [andere] christliche Mensch meide willig gesetzwidrigen Beischlaf und halte gesetzlich die geistlichen Rechtsordnungen.
And let every [other] Christian man also eagerly avoid unlawful intercourse and keep the laws of God rightly.
And all Christian men shall carefully avoid illicit unions, and duly observe the laws of the church.
And also every Christian man is zealously to avoid illegal intercourse, and duly keep the laws of the Church.
And every Christian must diligently avoid unlawful intercourse and rightly uphold the divine law.

note.label: explained in
note.quote: VI Ethelred 12–12.1 explains that this involves not marrying within six degrees of relationship

div.note: VI Ethelred 12–12.1 explains that this involves not marrying within six degrees of relationship, or with the widow of so near a kinsman, or a close relative of a previous wife, or a nun, or anyone related by spiritual affinity, or a deserted woman.
